findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "find_paint_color" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Look up a specific paint color by name or color number (e.g. 'Agreeable Gray', 'SW 7029', 'HC-154', 'Hale Navy Benjamin Moore') and get its brand, color number,…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
